section.content: 提供一种能够高效地进行机器学习的机器学习装置。机器学习装置具备：视觉执行部，其通过从机器人程序执行视觉执行命令，利用视觉传感器拍摄对象物(W)，并从拍摄到的拍摄图像检测或判定对象物(W)；结果取得部，其通过从机器人程序执行结果取得命令来取得对象物(W)的检测结果或判定结果；追加注释部，其通过从机器人程序执行注释命令，基于对象物(W)的图像的检测结果或判定结果，对拍摄图像赋予标签，取得新的学习数据；以及学习部，其通过从机器人程序执行学习命令，使用新的学习数据进行机器学习。

Provided is a machine learning device capable of efficiently performing machine learning. The machine learning device is provided with: a vision execution unit that images the object (W) with the vision sensor by executing a vision execution command from the robot program, and detects or determines the object (W) from the captured image; a result acquisition unit that acquires the detection result or determination result of the object (W) by acquiring a command from the robot program execution result; an additional annotation unit that tags the captured image based on the detection result or determination result of the image of the object (W) by executing an annotation command from the robot program, and acquires new learning data; and a learning unit that performs machine learning by executing a learning command from the robot program using the new learning data.

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning device.

Background

Conventionally, in a robot system, machine learning using a learner has been used as a method of detecting or inspecting an object from an image (for example, see patent document 1). In a robot system using machine learning, a task called annotation is required as an early stage of learning, and the annotation refers to associating a label such as whether or not a defective portion exists in an image or whether or not a detected position is correct with image data. The user confirms the annotations one by one, and determines whether or not there is a defective portion in the object in the image.

Documents of the prior art

Patent literature

Patent document 1: japanese laid-open patent publication No. 2018-151843

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

The annotation of images is typically done by the user. However, it takes time for the user to give a label to all teacher data. In addition, when learning is performed after all teacher data is gathered, it takes time until the system using machine learning is started. Therefore, in the machine learning device for the robot, it is required to perform machine learning efficiently.

Means for solving the problems

A machine learning device according to the present disclosure is a machine learning device for a robot using a vision sensor, including: a program setting unit that sets a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in a robot program for the robot; a vision execution unit that images an object using the vision sensor by executing the vision execution command from the robot program, and detects or determines the object from the captured image; a result acquisition unit that acquires a detection result or a determination result of the object by executing the result acquisition command from the robot program; an additional annotation unit that tags the captured image based on a detection result or a determination result of the image of the object by executing the annotation command from the robot program, and acquires new learning data; and a learning unit that performs machine learning using the new learning data by executing the learning command from the robot program.

A machine learning device according to the present disclosure is a machine learning device for a robot using a vision sensor, including: a program setting unit that sets at least 1 of a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in a robot program for the robot; a vision execution unit that images an object using the vision sensor by executing the robot program, and detects or determines the object from the captured image; a result acquisition unit that acquires a detection result or a determination result of the object by executing the robot program; an additional annotation unit that acquires new learning data by labeling the captured image based on a detection result or a determination result of the image of the object by executing the robot program; and a learning unit that performs machine learning by executing the robot program using the new learning data.

Effects of the invention

According to the present invention, machine learning can be efficiently performed.

Drawings

Fig. 1 shows a configuration of a robot system.

Fig. 2 shows a configuration of the robot controller.

Fig. 3 is a flowchart showing a processing flow of the machine learning device.

Fig. 4 is a flowchart showing a process of teaching a model pattern.

Fig. 5 shows an example of teaching a model pattern.

Fig. 6 shows an example of labeling the detection result.

Fig. 7 shows an example of extracting a partial image.

Fig. 8 is a flowchart showing a process of machine learning.

Detailed Description

An example of an embodiment of the present invention will be described below.

Fig. 1 shows a structure of a robot system 100. As shown in fig. 1, the robot system 100 includes a robot control device 1, a vision sensor control device 2, a robot 3, an arm 4, and a vision sensor 5.

A robot hand or a tool is attached to a tip end of the arm 4 of the robot 3. The robot 3 performs operations such as processing and machining of the object W under the control of the robot control device 1. Further, a vision sensor 5 is attached to a tip portion of the arm 4 of the robot 3. In addition, the vision sensor 5 may not be mounted on the robot 3, and may be fixed and disposed at a predetermined position, for example.

The vision sensor 5 captures an image of the object W under the control of the vision sensor control device 2. The vision sensor 5 may be a two-dimensional camera having an imaging element including a CCD (Charge Coupled Device) image sensor and an optical system including a lens, or a stereo camera capable of three-dimensional measurement.

The robot control device 1 executes a robot program for the robot 3 to control the operation of the robot 3. At this time, the robot controller 1 corrects the operation of the robot 3 so that the robot 3 performs a predetermined operation on the position of the object W detected by the vision sensor controller 2.

Fig. 2 shows a configuration of the robot controller 1. The robot control device 1 includes a machine learning device 10. The robot control device 1 has a general configuration for controlling the robot 3, but is omitted for simplicity of description. The machine learning device 10 is a device for the robot 3 to perform machine learning. The machine learning device 10 includes a control unit 11 and a storage unit 12.

The control Unit 11 is a processor such as a CPU (Central Processing Unit), and executes a program stored in the storage Unit 12 to implement various functions.

The control unit 11 includes a teaching unit 111, an object detection unit 112, a comment unit 113, an image processing unit 114, a learning unit 115, a program setting unit 116, a visual execution unit 117, a result acquisition unit 118, and an additional comment unit 119.

The storage unit 12 is a storage device such as a ROM (Read Only Memory) for storing an OS (Operating System) and an application program, a RAM (Random Access Memory), a hard disk Drive or an SSD (Solid State Drive) for storing other various information. The storage unit 12 stores various information such as a robot program.

Fig. 3 is a flowchart showing a processing flow of the machine learning device 10.

In step S1, the teaching section 111 teaches a model pattern representing the image feature of the object W. Fig. 4 is a flowchart showing a process of teaching a model pattern. Fig. 5 shows an example of teaching a model pattern.

In step S101, an object W to be taught as a model pattern is placed in the field of view of the vision sensor 5, and an image G of the object W is captured. It is preferable to perform imaging so that the positional relationship between the vision sensor 5 and the object W is the same as the positional relationship when the object W is detected.

In step S102, the teaching section 111 designates a region including the object W in the captured image G as a rectangular or circular model pattern designation region R.

In step S103, the teaching unit 111 extracts edge points as feature points within the range of the model pattern specification region, and obtains physical quantities such as the position, orientation (direction of the luminance gradient), and magnitude of the luminance gradient of the edge points. The teaching unit 111 defines a model pattern coordinate system in a designated area, and converts the position and orientation of the edge point from the values expressed in the image coordinate system S to the values expressed in the model pattern coordinate system.

In step S104, the physical quantities of the extracted edge points are stored in the storage unit 12 as feature points constituting the model pattern. In the present embodiment, edge points are used as feature points, but feature points such as well-known SIFT may be used.

Returning to fig. 3, in step S2, the object detection unit 112 detects an image of the object W from 1 or more input images including the object W using the model pattern. Specifically, first, 1 or more input images including an image of the object W are prepared. Then, the object detection unit 112 detects an image of the object W from 1 or more input images including the object W, respectively, using the model pattern.

In step S3, the annotating unit 113 labels (annotates) the detection result based on the determination of the detection result of the user for the object W.

Specifically, the detection result of the object W in step S2 is displayed on a display device or the like connected to the robot controller 1. The user visually confirms the detection result and gives a label such as OK or NG to the detection result. Fig. 6 shows an example in which a label is given to the detection result. In the example of fig. 6, the annotating unit 113 assigns an NG label to 2 images G and an OK label to 6 images G.

For example, if the detection result is false detection or failure, the user assigns a label of NG. The user may assign an OK tag when the detection result is equal to or greater than a predetermined threshold value, and assign an NG tag when the detection result is less than the predetermined threshold value. In addition, the user may correct the label automatically given by the machine learning device 10. In the above description, the labels are classified by 2 levels of OK and NG, but classification by 3 or more levels may be used.

In step S4, the image processing unit 114 associates the image based on the input image with the tag, and uses the image based on the input image and the tag as the learning data. For example, the image processing unit 114 extracts a partial image including the object W from the input image, associates the partial image with the tag, and sets the partial image and the tag as learning data.

Specifically, the image processing unit 114 extracts (cuts out) a partial image of a predetermined region at a position and orientation detected from the input image. Fig. 7 shows an example of extracting a partial image. In the example of fig. 7, the image processing section 114 extracts partial images G11, G12, G13, and G14 from the image G1. Then, the image processing unit 114 associates the extracted partial image with the label assigned in step S3, and sets the partial image and the label as learning data.

In step S5, the learning unit 115 performs machine learning using the learning data. Specifically, the learning unit 115 performs machine learning using a learning data set that is a set of learning data. Fig. 8 is a flowchart showing a process of machine learning. The learning model can use an SVM (Support Vector Machine) or a neural network.

In step S201, the image processing unit 114 extracts (cuts) a partial image including the object W from the input image, associates the partial image with the tag, and sets the partial image and the tag as learning data.

In step S202, the learning unit 115 inputs each pixel value of the partial image to the learning model, and calculates a degree of coincidence (score). Here, the degree of coincidence is made to be a value of 0 to 1.

In step S203, the learning unit 115 calculates an error from the calculated matching degree (score), and the error is 1.0 if the label of the detection result is correct, or 0.0 if it is incorrect.

In step S204, the learning unit 115 feeds back an error to the learning model, and updates the parameters of the learning model. Then, the learning unit 115 repeats such processing the same number of times as the number (N) of detection results used for learning.

Returning to fig. 3, in step S6, the program setting unit 116 sets a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in the robot program for the robot 3. The program setting unit 116 may set at least 1 of a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in the robot program.

Here, the VISION execution command (VISION _ FIND) is to take an image of the object W by the VISION sensor 5, and detect or determine the object W from the taken image. The RESULT acquisition command (VISION _ GET _ RESULT) acquires the detection RESULT or determination RESULT of the object W. The comment command (VISION _ comment) labels the captured image based on the detection result or determination result of the image of the object W. The LEARNING command (VISION _ LEARNING) performs machine LEARNING using the LEARNING data.

In this way, by setting each command for machine learning in the robot program, the machine learning device 10 can call each command from the robot program.

In step S7, the vision execution unit 117 executes a vision execution command from the robot program, images the object W with the vision sensor 5, and detects or determines the object W from the captured image. In the present embodiment, the detection of the object W means that the position and posture of the object W are detected to obtain a detection result, and the determination of the object W means that the object W is inspected to obtain determination results such as OK/NG and type.

In step S8, the result acquisition unit 118 acquires the detection result or the determination result of the object W by executing the result acquisition command from the robot program.

In step S9, the additional annotation unit 119 executes an annotation command from the robot program, and tags the captured image based on the detection result or determination result of the image of the object W to acquire new learning data. In this way, since the robot program can execute the comment command, the machine learning device 10 can perform a comment optimal for the robot system 100 using the robot 3.

In step S10, the learning unit 115 executes a learning command from the robot program, and performs machine learning using the new learning data acquired in step S9.

The robot program including the above-described visual execution command, result acquisition command, comment command, and learning command is as follows, for example. The description in parentheses indicates each operation of the robot program.

MOVE _ TO PX (MOVED TO POSITION X)

VISION _ FIND "VP1" (executing Vision program VP 1)

VISION _ GET _ RESULT "VP1" DATA [1] (deriving the decision from the Vision program VP 1)

IF DATA [1]. CONFIDENCE < 30 (in the case where the certainty of the determination result is less than 30)

VISION _ ANNOTATE (DATA [1], DATA [1]. LABEL) (learning DATA is added as a determination result)

ENDIF

VISION _ LEARNING (executive LEARNING)

Additionally, the exemplary robot program described above uses certainty. By learning the learning data with low certainty, the accuracy of the learning model can be further improved. Confidence is calculated based on a loss (loss) function. The confidence level may be calculated using known methods.

Note that the comment command may change the label depending on whether or not the robot 3 successfully grips the object based on the detection result of the image of the object W. In this case, the robot program executes the following processing, for example.

(1) The robot 3 is moved to the position X.

(2) And executing the visual execution command to detect the object.

(3) And executing the result obtaining command to obtain the detection result.

(4) The robot arm 4 of the robot 3 is moved to the detection position.

(5) The object W is gripped by the robot arm 4.

(6) It is determined whether the grasping is successful.

(7) In the case of successful grasping, the comment command is given to the tag of 1 (successful grasping).

(8) In the case of a grip failure, the comment command is given a label of 0 (grip failure).

(9) Repeating the treatments (2) to (8).

(10) The learning command is executed.

By performing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model corresponding to whether or not the gripping of the object is successful, using the image and the detection result.

The object W may be inspected by another apparatus (for example, an accurate inspection apparatus). Note that the comment command may be a label given to the result of the inspection of the object W using another device. In this case, the robot program executes the following processing, for example.

(1) The robot 3 is moved to the position X.

(2) And executing the visual execution command to detect the object.

(3) And executing the result obtaining command to obtain the detection result.

(4) The determination (inspection) is performed in another device. The determination result is checked by the user.

(5) And executing the annotation command, and adding the judgment result of other devices into the learning data.

(6) The learning command is executed.

By executing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model for determining the object W from the image. The machine learning device 10 can perform determination only by the learning model without using the determination result of another device after learning.

Note that the comment command may be configured to label the detection result when the score of the detection result of the object W is smaller than a predetermined threshold value. In this case, the robot program executes the following processing, for example.

(1) The robot 3 is moved to the position X.

(2) And executing the visual execution command to detect the object.

(3) And executing the result obtaining command to obtain the detection result.

(4) It is determined whether the score of the detection result is less than a predetermined threshold.

(5) In the case where the score of the detection result is smaller than a predetermined threshold value, the detection position is put in the learning data in the comment command.

(6) The learning command is executed.

By executing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model for returning the position of the object W from the image.

As described above, according to the present embodiment, the machine learning device 10 for the robot 3 using the vision sensor 5 includes: a program setting unit 116 that sets a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in a robot program for the robot 3; a vision execution unit 117 that images the object W with the vision sensor 5 by executing a vision execution command from the robot program, and detects or determines the object W from the captured image; a result acquisition unit 118 that acquires the detection result or the determination result of the object W by acquiring a command from the robot program execution result; an additional annotation unit 119 that tags the captured image based on the detection result or determination result of the image of the object W by executing an annotation command from the robot program, and acquires new learning data; and a learning unit 115 that performs machine learning using new learning data by executing a learning command from the robot program.

Thus, the machine learning device 10 can perform annotation and learning while operating the robot by the robot program, and therefore can efficiently perform machine learning. Therefore, by using the machine learning device 10, the robot system 100 can be started quickly.

The comment command may change the label depending on whether or not the robot 3 successfully grips the object based on the detection result of the image of the object W. By performing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model corresponding to whether or not the grasping of the object is successful, using the image and the detection result. Therefore, the machine learning device 10 can grasp the workpiece with a high probability of being graspable by the robot 3.

The object W may be determined by another device, and the comment command may be given a label to the result of determination of the object W by the other device. By executing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model for determining the object W from the image. The machine learning device 10 can perform determination only by the learning model without using the determination result of another device after learning.

In addition, the comment command assigns the tag to the detection result when the score of the detection result of the object W is smaller than a predetermined threshold value. By executing such processing, the machine learning device 10 can obtain a learning model of the position of the object W returned from the image. Therefore, the machine learning device 10 can efficiently perform machine learning using such a learning model.

The machine learning device 10 further includes: a teaching unit 111 for teaching a model pattern representing a feature of an image of the object W; an object detection unit 112 that detects an image of the object W from 1 or more input images including the object W using the model pattern; a labeling unit 113 that labels the detection result of the object W based on the detection result; an image processing unit 114 that associates an image based on an input image with a tag, and uses the image based on the input image and the tag as learning data; and a learning unit 115 that performs machine learning using the learning data. This enables the machine learning device 10 to perform appropriate learning.

In the above embodiment, the case of 1 machine learning device 10 was described, but a machine learning system in which a plurality of machine learning devices 10 are present may be used. When there are a plurality of machine learning apparatuses 10, the learning model stored in any one of the machine learning apparatuses 10 can be shared with another machine learning apparatus 10. If a plurality of machine learning devices 10 share a learning model, learning can be distributed among the machine learning devices 10, and therefore the machine learning system can improve learning efficiency.

The embodiments of the present invention have been described above, but the present invention is not limited to the above embodiments. The effects described in the present embodiment are merely the most preferable effects produced by the present invention, and the effects of the present invention are not limited to the effects described in the present embodiment.
